This is one dissent recorded in a manifesto about sustaining human knowledge in the age of AI. Which fault line does it fall on?

Options:
- consent_or_payment: consent and payment mechanism: opt-in / levies / dues on existing text vs open training, pay at output, contracts for new work (Salib, Bratton, O'Reilly against the majority)
- model_in_loop: whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room at all (Becker, Turkle)
- other: anything else

Text:

Checker and journalism money should come from public sources rather than voluntary lab money, and the manifesto should drop "AGI" and anthropomorphic verbs.
raw: {"choice":"other","why":"The dissent argues that \"Checker and journalism money should come from public sources rather than voluntary lab money\" and asks to drop \"AGI\" and anthropomorphic verbs. That is a dispute over who funds public-interest work and over framing language. It is not about consent, levies or opt-in for training text versus open training, so it is not consent_or_payment. It also does not question whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room, so it is not model_in_loop."}

That is a dispute over who funds public-interest work and over framing language. It is not about consent, levies or opt-in for training text versus open training, so it is not consent_or_payment. It also does not question whether a model belongs in the checking loop or the room, so it is not model_in_loop.
